EmailTemplate.subject: 2026 Deposit & Refund Policy – Land Tours (action required)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [Client/Group Organizer Name],
Please find attached the official 2026 Deposit Payment and Refund Policy from Land Tours.
This document outlines:
Confirmation and deposit requirements (50% initial deposit, remaining 50% due 120 days prior to tour start)
How deposits are used for hotels, transportation, and services
Cancellation timeframes and applicable refund amounts (including the $1,000 per person administrative fee)
Accepted payment methods and processing fees
Our refund processing timeline
All cancellations must be submitted in writing. We strongly recommend sharing this policy with every member of your group to avoid misunderstandings.
If you have any questions or need clarification before signing, please reply to this email.
Thank you for choosing Land Tours as your ground handler in Ghana and West Africa.
Best regards, Land Tours Operations [Your Phone Number] | [Your Email Address] Reliable ground handling · Ghana · West Africa
